deviceSuspendedMarker: Quad Cortex has suspended host control
presetCatalogRefreshUnavailable: The Quad Cortex publishes its complete preset directory once at the start of each USB session and then pushes File updates as the library changes. This host serves that retained directory and does not send an explicit directory refresh: the unit does answer a directory read when asked (observed on CorOS 4.1.0, 2026-10-07), but a refresh is not implemented here. Omit refresh to read the retained directory, or reconnect the device session to pull a new one.
